messages.en: This character has an ACTIVE Marine affiliation and a bounty. The World Government does not issue bounties on its own Marines — unless this is a Cross Guild bounty (set `issued_by`), or the membership has ended (set `until` on the relation).
messages.fr: Ce personnage a une affiliation Marine ACTIVE et une prime. Le Gouvernement Mondial n’émet pas de prime contre ses propres Marines — sauf prime Cross Guild (renseignez `issued_by`) ou affiliation terminée (renseignez `until` sur la relation).
